summary.en: Holds one line, that the generating go on, with 开 as a process-state and not a quantity; a diagnosis of how worlds close; and a constructive programme (exit, abundance commons, assurance, plurality). title.en: The selfishness spiral and narrative-value frames

summary.en: Actors act from environment-written ranked frames; a 'selfish' frame compounds through four loops toward plural endgames. title.en: 智善: intelligence must be good

summary.en: A developed normative programme: competition that selects survivors hands winners the rule, totalization is loss of independent capacity, so AI must not fight for any party. The account states some of the mechanism, conditionally and on models, under narrower words: agreement with a checked law's form holds for single mechanisms, not for the programme. Several further links are forms a law has, proposed here and not stated by the account, and live readings of the corpus's own meta-attractor count by descent, not as independent agreement. The programme asserts what the account only states conditionally or not at all: intelligence must be good; whatever continues 生生 is good; evil is owning a gate; generative centers hold standing; irreversible closure has priority; freedom is exit power; provenance gives the commons a claim; AI must not be a party; the current direction must stop. The account holds such orderings under the continuation condition (scope) and C (order), neither asserted, with J1 to J4 further, and T8 claims no verdict binding every possible mind. On its models it denies that "AI for all" is the only equilibrium and that changeability removes every plea, and it keeps a witness in which a closing pays every party.

summary.en: The account holds Chinese Buddhist texts at length (dossier, corpus, Lean tests of 146 sentences), mostly as the strongest contrary test: its continuation stands on the side 中论 refutes. Chapters and fronts hold almost nothing else: no twelve links, craving, saṃsāra, nirvāṇa, 无我 or suffering. Those mapped in the 脉络 study have no entries here, so this file's totals do not show that absence; coverage's absent list does. No entry here is agreement, of a law or otherwise, and I looked: the nearest are parts of entries; agreement stands only in the earlier maps under coverage. Most entries are this crosswalk's own proposals, contrary or divergent, not connections the account states; what is carried in part rests on the dossier, a live page unread by any person, not on a chapter. 无明 keeps the name and changes the claim. Sharpest finds: 雜阿含 293's 相續滅，是名苦邊 and 青目's refutation of 不住相似生, in no map or count. The dossier's statement that Tiantai is not in the repository is out of date.

summary.en: Absent from the live account as a body of thought, by search: no Indian text or school is named. What exists is one Sanskrit gloss, two 'karmic' clauses, one remark naming South Asia, and dossier B's divergence on release, on a Buddhist reading. The account itself states only that some effects of activity persist and condition what follows, with no store and no valence. All else is proposed here from AI knowledge, unchecked against any text, with no reader from these traditions. No agreement is of `law`: where a checked law's form is named, the join is this crosswalk's. Divergence is the item's main finding, chiefly on a self beyond relation, on loss, on release and on a moral order of fruit. Structural agreement is not agreement in meaning, and no tradition is spoken for.

summary.en: Meadows's traps, Senge's archetypes, Forrester, Beer, Holling, Luhmann, second-order cybernetics, Ashby, Wiener and Ostrom, from AI knowledge with no source text checked. The live account itself names few of them: overshoot and the commons as restated in near-definitional arithmetic, requisite variety read on relations, the good regulator as not proved, Bateson's levels as a scheme with no law of possibility, autopoiesis as a neighbour its models lie below, Ostrom on boundary rules. Most other connections here are this crosswalk's proposals, labelled so. Agreement with a checked law's form is narrow: a count lock for success to the successful, delayed correction, qualitative requisite variety, and Ashby's recursion into basins. No law states burden-shifting, underinvestment, the adaptive cycle, viable-system structure, rival goals on one stock, a stock raised by reading the other's, evasion's learning or hysteresis. Divergence is kept as prominently: feedback as purpose; Beer's organs against constraints "not survival axioms"; a ranked list where no law ranks; "more options are better", where any order needs C or a premise in its place and scope the continuation condition, neither asserted; constructivism; Luhmann, whose centrelessness stands as the contrary reading; self-governance.

summary.en: The account restates thresholds, rest, recurrence, merges and openness in discrete steps and whole amounts, by its own verdict restated, level or states less; where it agrees it is mostly with laws its records credit to the field. It states exact thresholds for the fold's form, a periphery fold and transcritical end, per-graph threshold laws, a critical-mass band in a constant, bounds on carried differences and cycle witnesses. It has no law of hysteresis or a path through a band, Hopf crossing, critical rate of a regime, escape time beyond geometric bounds, an absorbing-state transition, Turing's instability, self-organized criticality, percolation or dissipative structure; bounded chaos stands only in a history page. Compositions for hysteresis and rate stay here as proposals, not results. It diverges on the attractor, on a phase transition's word, on direction, and with a cycle under mutual support against Thomas's rule for flows. I looked for contrary reading and found none.

title.en: Psychology, AI alignment and logic

summary.en: Three fields in one row. Alignment and logic have their own dossiers and credits, and this row maps what those leave. Bostrom, Löb, Moloch and value lock-in go unnamed; natural selection among AIs, influence-seeking and gradual disempowerment are only asked about. Psychology is sparse by name: habit alone is credited, and the links offered for addiction, helplessness, confirmation bias and attachment are this crosswalk's proposals, not the account's. Agreement with a checked law's form stands only for habit's count, Lawvere's diagonal and the calibrations, none claimed as new mathematics; any other agreement is a reader's join. Divergences kept: Turner's theorem is a different question, helplessness's authors reversed the mechanism that fits, addiction's harm is no law's word, disempowerment's object is not ranked. No entry is a contrary reading; contrary evidence stays inside the entries: de Wit on human habit, Heyman, Franzén.
